summary: Full frontend UI regression for offline PWA SK Bike. All 15 scenarios in the review request passed: storefront renders 8 seeded cards with price/code hidden; category filter (BMX -> 2 cards, Semua -> 8), sort asc (cheapest first: SK Junior 16 Rp1.45M) and sort desc (most expensive first: SK E-Trail 750W Rp22.5M), catalog search ('Enduro' -> 1) all work; WhatsApp floating pop-out opens with 3 quick options and custom input; /admin/login rejects wrong password with error text 'Email atau kata sandi salah' and accepts correct env-based creds (bryan.halim007@gmail.com/velox2026) redirecting to /admin; dashboard stat cards render (Total 8, Kategori 5, Stok 8, Nilai Rp711.550.000) and table shows both price and code; full CRUD (add TEST_Bike_QA / edit -> TEST_Bike_QA_Edited / delete via confirm-delete-button) works and reflects on storefront while keeping code/price hidden; localStorage persistence verified via full page reload; admin-search-input filters table to 1 row; logout returns to /admin/login and /admin is protected (redirects to login). No console errors observed.

ui_bugs.issue: Inner div (line 45, .relative.flex.items-center.gap-3) intercepts pointer events over the [data-testid=whatsapp-popout-close] button, forcing testers to use force=True. Real users can still close via ESC/outside click, but the X button hit-area is unreliable.

issues: 'Total Kategori' shows 5 (only categories with products) while CATEGORIES constant defines 8. Consider labeling it 'Kategori Terpakai' or showing 8/8 to avoid confusion.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Fix pointer-events overlay so the WhatsApp popout close X button is clickable without force=True.
(Optional) Clarify 'Total Kategori' semantics on admin dashboard (5 used vs 8 defined).
critical_code_review_comments: store.js: ADMIN credentials fall back to hardcoded 'bryan.halim007@gmail.com'/'velox2026' if env vars are missing; acceptable for offline PWA but consider removing the literal fallback for production builds.
Session token stored in plain localStorage (no httpOnly cookie possible for a serverless PWA) — documented in-code, acceptable per product requirement (100% offline).
Base64-inlined image uploads in ProductForm can bloat localStorage quickly; add a size cap / compression warning.
